previous_plan.rationale: M=32 makes block_M=32 the only height that divides M; block_M=64 is retained as a harmless domain fallback that the deterministic builder excludes via the divisibility rule, preserving MIP tension without changing feasible selections. N=K=4096 support block_N in {64,128} and block_K in {32,64}; num_stages 1-3 and threads=128 (only allowed value). The 49152-byte cap filters the largest 2*64*(32+128)*3=61440-byte tuple, keeping genuine pipeline-vs-footprint tension. Given the workload's small M, traffic is dominated by 1/block_M which is fixed at 1/32, so traffic sensitivity is modest; the meaningful tradeoff is block_N (affects traffic via 1/block_N and launches) and pipeline depth vs footprint via num_stages/block_K. Weights keep traffic and pipeline at 1.0, reduce launches to 0.25 because ceil(32/32)=1 row-tile makes launch count nearly invariant, and keep footprint at 0.5 since it mainly acts through the shared-memory constraint. This is formulation-only MIP configuration; CPU-shadow correctness and latency do not establish CUDA correctness or GB10 performance, no timing is claimed without SASS, and compilation remains blocked so no GPU results are verified.
